report:
Your understanding is correct: **ivermectin does not lower the risk of death in COVID-19.** 

### Key Evidence

* **Large Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs):** Rigorous clinical trials show no significant mortality benefit. The multi-center TOGETHER trial evaluated outpatient ivermectin treatment and found no reduction in hospitalizations or mortality compared to placebo. Similarly, the randomized I-TECH trial in high-risk patients demonstrated that ivermectin did not reduce disease progression or death.
* **Systematic Reviews:** A comprehensive Cochrane Systematic Review concluded there is no convincing evidence that ivermectin prevents death, clinical worsening, or infection in COVID-19 patients. Subsequent meta-analyses focused on low-bias RCTs confirmed that ivermectin does not reduce all-cause mortality or the need for mechanical ventilation.
* **Context of Early Claims:** Initial interest stemmed from laboratory cell-culture studies that required drug concentrations far exceeding safe human doses, as well as early small trials with high risk of bias or methodological flaws. When tested in large, well-controlled human trials, no clinical benefit was observed.

Major medical authorities, including the NIH and WHO, recommend against using ivermectin for COVID-19 treatment outside of clinical trials.

### Sources
* Cochrane Systematic Review: https://www.cochrane.org/evidence/CD015017_ivermectin-preventing-and-treating-covid-19
* The New England Journal of Medicine (TOGETHER Trial): https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2115869
* JAMA Internal Medicine (I-TECH Trial): https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamainternalmedicine/fullarticle/2789362
* BMC Infectious Diseases Meta-Analysis: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12879-022-07589-8
